Vigilance à l’égard de la clientèle

A regulatory requirement obligating banks and financial institutions to verify the identity and assess the risk of customers as part of AML/CFT controls.

Questions and answers

What is Vigilance à l’égard de la clientèle?

In this glossary, Vigilance à l’égard de la clientèle refers to: A regulatory requirement obligating banks and financial institutions to verify the identity and assess the risk of customers as part of AML/CFT controls.

How is Vigilance à l’égard de la clientèle used in finance?

In finance communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "La vigilance à l’égard de la clientèle est obligatoire avant toute ouverture de compte."

Why does Vigilance à l’égard de la clientèle matter in finance?

Vigilance à l’égard de la clientèle matters because it supports clear communication in Banking contexts for Financial Analysts, Bankers, and Traders. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as CFA, ACCA, and FRM.
